messages:
Maya (Design): quick design review — compact catalog row: the filter chips feel visually heavy at current density. suggest reducing chip vertical padding and lowering badge saturation.

Jon (PM): +1. main product ask: make version anchoring (lock-to-version) more discoverable. hard to tell when compare mode is holding a locked version.

Priya (Eng): question — do we want a persistent UI affordance or just a transient tooltip? implementation-wise toggling a `version_lock` param feels easiest.

Sam (Frontend): my take: show a small lock icon as part of the row header, with a visible state (left border + subtle bg). aria: use `role=button` + `aria-pressed`. keyboard shortcut idea: maybe `L` to toggle? open to debate.

Ada (A11y): small note: only use `aria-pressed` on elements that behave like buttons. if we do a non-button element, add `role=button`. add visually-hidden state text like 'Version locked'. also double-check focus order when rows change.

Maya (Design): mock described: lock chip on the far left of compact row; performance badges (latency / throughput) sit to the right of title. need to ensure badge order doesn't shift when locking toggles.

Jon (PM): product constraint: performance badges must be stable DOM-wise to avoid perceived flicker. keep them in the same sequence; update values, not position.

Priya (Eng): re: compare table + filters — currently changing filters causes rows to reflow abruptly. can we add skeleton placeholders or animate height to reduce jank?

Sam (Frontend): plan: skeleton rows + CSS transition. quick snippet: ```css
.row-skeleton { min-height: 40px; transition: height 120ms ease; }
``` this should smooth most cases.

Ada (A11y): when replacing with skeletons, ensure focus is preserved. use `aria-live='polite'` for content updates so screenreaders get a subtle cue. avoid removing focused elements from DOM if possible.

Maya (Design): copy nit: 'Pin version' seems ambiguous in context. alternatives: 'Lock version', 'Anchor version'. thoughts?

Jon (PM): prefer 'Lock version' — concise. tooltip: 'Lock version to compare models across updates'. keep the tooltip copy short.

Priya (Eng): technical: store lock in URL as `?version_lock=sha` so team members can share views. backwards-compatible fallback if param absent.

Sam (Frontend): also thinking about filter chip overflow: when >6 filters show a `+N` overflow chip that opens a menu. example: `+3` chip. keeps toolbar compact.

Ada (A11y): overflow menu must be keyboard accessible: focusable, open via Enter/Space, arrow key navigation inside, and close on Esc. label the chip with `aria-haspopup='menu'` and `aria-expanded` state.

Maya (Design): visual polish: tone down badge glow; use 0.6 opacity secondary background for less visual weight. switch to colorblind-friendly palette for perf badges.

Jon (PM): agree — also add a micro-legend in the header with a `?` tooltip explaining badge colors. small educational affordance for customers.

Priya (Eng): blockers? I can implement the URL param + basic lock state this sprint if design + a11y copy is final.

Maya (Design): i'll update mocks and provide final copy by EOD tomorrow and attach Figma link here. @Ada can you draft accessible labels?

Ada (A11y): will do. checklist: role/button, `aria-pressed`, sr-only state text, keyboard interactions, live-region notes. i'll post the checklist and sample HTML snippets.

Sam (Frontend): i'll prototype skeletons and the overflow chip, push a draft PR to `catalog-ui/compact-lock` branch.

Jon (PM): awesome. next steps: Maya mock, Ada a11y checklist, Sam PR, Priya wired URL param. sync Wed standup to confirm. :thumbsup:
